Shields: Deflector Generator (Tiny): Projects forward, aft, port and starboard deflector shields. While a facing has charges, the ship gains +5 AC against attacks from that 90° quarter. Each attack from that quarter whose total meets or beats the ship's base AC spends 1 charge from that facing, whether the shield turns it aside or not. Each facing holds 3 charges. A facing at 0 charges is down until the Engineer raises it again. Track charges on the bridge HUD. A ship mounts one deflector generator.

One of the ship's areas ices over and its systems seize until thawed. Put a Freeze Mishap encounter in the area of the ship that was hit.

Reference actor only. Not in any component's mishap list.
Place a Rigging-Failure Mishap encounter somewhere among the rigging.
Place a Wind-Sheer Mishap encounter somewhere on the ship.
The ship's hull or a bulkhead tears open. The area vents, floods, or loses lift, depending on the current element. Put a Rupture Mishap encounter in the area of the ship that was hit.
The power system core begins to overload. Put an Overload Mishap encounter in the Ship's Power system.
The ship loses power. Add a Power Hungry Mishap encounter to the ship's Power System.
